Overview

This notebook compares matched samples with _G and _R suffixes as paired primer designs at the same locus. The analysis uses the DAF-QC-SMK outputs in each sample directory together with yield.tsv.

sample_info %>%
    select(sample, pair, primer_strategy, ng_per_uL, total_ng) %>%
    arrange(pair, primer_strategy) %>%

Yield comparison

# Paired yield trajectories show direction and magnitude for each locus.
yield_plot <- plot_paired_metric(
    yield_long,
    total_ng,
    y_label = "Total PCR yield (ng)",
    title = "PCR yield by primer strategy",
    log10_scale = TRUE
)

yield_plot

Targeting metrics

# Faceted targeting counts compare full-length, partial, and off-target reads.
targeting_plot <- ggplot(targeting_long, aes(x = primer_strategy, y = count, group = pair, color = pair)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.9, guide = "none") +
    labs(
        x = "Primer strategy",
        y = "Read count",
        title = "Targeting metrics by primer strategy"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

targeting_plot

# Proportion view controls for depth differences between samples.
targeting_prop_plot <- ggplot(targeting_props_long, aes(x = primer_strategy, y = proportion, group = pair, color = pair)) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.9, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
        x = "Primer strategy",
        y = "Fraction of total fibers",
        title = "Targeting proportions by primer strategy"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

targeting_prop_plot

Strand bias

# Retain chimera/undetermined/none as explicit quality categories.
strand_prop_long <- sample_strand_summary %>%
    select(sample, pair, primer, primer_strategy, ct_prop, ga_prop, chimera_prop, undetermined_prop, none_prop) %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(ct_prop, ga_prop, chimera_prop, undetermined_prop, none_prop),
        names_to = "category",
        values_to = "proportion"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        category = recode(
            category,
            ct_prop = "CT",
            ga_prop = "GA",
            chimera_prop = "Chimera",
            undetermined_prop = "Undetermined",
            none_prop = "None"
        ),
        category = factor(category, levels = c("CT", "GA", "Chimera", "Undetermined", "None"))
    )

strand_plot <- ggplot(strand_prop_long, aes(x = primer_strategy, y = proportion, fill = category)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~ pair, ncol = 2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(
        x = "Primer strategy",
        y = "Fraction of all reads",
        fill = "Read class",
        title = "Strand and quality-class composition by sample pair"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

strand_plot

# Main bias comparison: CT fraction among informative CT/GA reads only.
strand_bias_plot <- plot_paired_metric(
    sample_strand_summary,
    ct_fraction,
    y_label = "CT fraction among informative reads",
    title = "Strand bias by primer strategy"
)

strand_bias_plot + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1))

Deamination rates

# Box/jitter show read-level distributions; line overlays show paired medians.
deam_plot <- ggplot(deamination_long, aes(x = primer_strategy, y = rate, group = pair, color = pair)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(group = primer_strategy), outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.25, width = 0.55) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.15, size = 0.6) +
    geom_line(data = deamination_medians, aes(y = median_rate, group = pair), alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(data = deamination_medians, aes(y = median_rate), size = 1.8, alpha = 0.9) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", nrow = 2) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(end = 0.9, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
        x = "Primer strategy",
        y = "Deamination rate",
        title = "Deamination rates by primer strategy"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

deam_plot

Notes

  • The main paired comparisons treat each matched _G and _R sample as a pair.
  • Strand bias testing focuses on CT versus GA reads; chimera, undetermined, and none remain visible as separate quality categories.
  • Deamination summaries are read-level summaries from the detailed sequence metrics table, so the distributions reflect all informative reads rather than only region-level aggregates.
